title: AI-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts
description:
HIRING: 2 AI-Augmented Full Stack Developers — Claude Code Experts

We're Not a Startup. We're a $8M Company That Just Decided to Eat the Software Market.


Contract → Full-Time | Remote | 8 AM – 6 PM EST | Monday to Saturday - Start Immediately

First, Let's Talk About Why Your Current Gig Sucks

You already know this, but let's say it out loud:


1. You sit in meetings about meetings. Three hours of \"alignment sessions\" so six people can

approve a button color. Meanwhile, we ship entire features before lunch.


2. Your PRs rot in review queues for days. You wrote the code Monday. It's Thursday. Dave still hasn't looked at it. Dave is \"swamped.\" Here? PR goes up, gets reviewed same day, ships same day.


3. You're a cog and you know it. You own a slice of a microservice that serves a widget inside a dashboard that nobody uses. Here, you own entire product surfaces end-to-end — UI, API, database, deployment. Your name is on it.


4. The \"innovation\" is a lie. They said \"move fast and break things\" in the job post. What they meant was \"move at the speed of legal review and break nothing, ever, including your spirit.\" We actually move fast. Uncomfortably fast.


5. Your tools are chosen by committee. You're stuck on Jenkins pipelines from 2017 and a Jira board with 14 custom fields. We use Claude Code CLI, Linear, GitHub, Vercel, and that's about it. Clean. Fast. Done.


6. The tech debt is someone else's mess and now it's your problem. You inherited a codebase that looks like it was written by 47 different people across 3 continents over 6 years. Because it was. We're building from scratch with modern architecture and AI-first workflows.


7. You have zero ownership. You don't know the customers. You don't see the revenue. You don't feel the impact. Here, you'll watch real call center operators use what you built and hear them say \"this changes everything.\" That's not marketing copy — that's Tuesday.


8. Your compensation is \"competitive\" (it's not). They gave you a 3% raise and called it generous. We do competitive salary + performance bonuses + profit sharing + PTO. You want to write your own ticket? Prove you're an A-player and the money follows.


9. Nobody cares how fast you are. You could ship 10x what your team does and you'd get the same review score as the person who refactored a README. We measure output: PRs merged, features shipped, products launched. Speed is the currency here.


10. You're building someone else's dream. Some VP's pet project. Some board member's \"strategic initiative.\" Here, you're building products for an industry we've spent a decade mastering — and you get a real stake in the outcome.


Who We Are (And Why You Should Care)


I've spent 10 years building and owning call centers. Not advising them. Not consulting for them. Running them. We did $8 million last year in the call center world. We know every pain point, every inefficiency, every moment where operators think \"there has to be a better way.\"

Now there is. We're pivoting to SaaS — and we're building the software suite that the entire call center industry has been waiting for. AI-powered call routing, real-time analytics, agent management, voice AI integration — the whole stack.


Our position is unfair and we like it that way:

  • We have deep domain expertise (10 years, $8M revenue, real operator relationships)
  • We have cash flow — we're not burning runway praying for product-market fit
  • We're raising capital to pour fuel on the fire, but we don't need it to survive
  • We're using Claude Code CLI to build at 5-10x the speed of traditional teams
  • We're bringing our first product to market right now , with a full suite behind it


Two developers + Claude Code + a founder who knows the industry cold = a team that outproduces companies with 10x the headcount. That's not theory. That's the plan.


The Role: What You'll Actually Do Every Day


You'll use Claude Code CLI as your primary development tool , running parallel sessions across git worktrees while maintaining production-quality standards. This isn't \"use AI sometimes.\" This is AI-first development where you orchestrate multiple coding agents and own the output.


Daily work:

  • Build features end-to-end: UI → API → database → tests → deployment
  • Run 3–8 parallel Claude Code instances across worktrees
  • Write and maintain CLAUDE.md project files and agent configurations
  • Decompose features into agent-executable specifications
  • Review, test, and refine AI-generated code for production readiness
  • Ship 2–4 PRs per day (yes, per day)
  • Record quick Loom demos of shipped features


Tech stack:

  • TypeScript (primary), Python (secondary)
  • Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
  • PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Redis
  • Vapi / LiveKit for voice AI
  • Vercel + Supabase for deployment
  • Claude Code CLI — this is the job


Must-Have Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

Experience & Skills:

  • 5+ years professional development experience
  • Deep Claude Code CLI proficiency — you should be able to show me your CLAUDE.md from a real project
  • Strong TypeScript + Python
  • React / Next.js production experience
  • PostgreSQL and data modeling chops
  • Git mastery: rebasing, worktrees, bisect, clean history — not just commit and push
  • Test-driven development habits
  • Excellent written English


Work Setup (No Exceptions):

  • High-end computer — your machine needs to handle multiple Claude Code instances, local dev servers, and Docker without breaking a sweat. If your laptop fans sound like a jet engine opening VS Code, this isn't the gig.
  • High-end internet — stable, fast connection. You're screen-sharing, pushing code, and running cloud deploys all day. Laggy internet = laggy output.
  • Available 8 AM – 6 PM EST, Monday –Saturday — 10-hour days. We work hard. I work 80-hour weeks. I'm asking you for 60. That's the deal.
  • Reliability is everything — show up, communicate, deliver. Every day. No disappearing acts.


Communication is IMPERATIVE:


This cannot be overstated. You need to be a clear, proactive communicator. Daily async standups. Responsive on Slack. Articulate in PRs. If something's blocked, you say so immediately — not two days later. We're a small, fast team. Communication gaps don't just slow us down, they kill momentum.


The Transparency Section

We use time tracking software. Not because we're micromanagers — because we're building trust with accountability. Honest work gets honest pay. Simple.


You work 10-hour days. Monday through Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM EST. This is a high-intensity, high-output role. We're bringing a product to market and building a suite behind it. If you want work-life balance right now, I respect that, but this isn't the role. If you want to build something massive and get rewarded for it, keep reading.


We move at startup speed with real-company cash. That means you get the excitement of building from zero without the anxiety of wondering if payroll clears next month.

What You Get


Competitive salary — real money, not \"equity only\"

Performance bonuses — ship fast, get paid more. Directly tied to output.

Profit sharing — we win, you win. Not a poster on the wall. Real checks.

️ Paid time off — because burned-out developers write burned-out code

title: Automotive Product Owner
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

Environment & Collaboration

Tools & Ways of Working

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node Senior
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

  • Conhecimentos em arquiteturas de software, como:
  • Monolito;
  • Microserviços;

  • DDD (Domain-Driven Design);

title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development . This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments , and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.


You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications , with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.

  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies , including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store .
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle , from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs .
  • Proficiency with Git , Xcode , and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager .
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit , Combine , Async/Await , CoreData , or Realm .
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.

title: Graphic Designer (Toys and Baby Gear)
description:
About Us:

Move2Play is a rapidly growing kids toy company in the e-commerce space. We were founded with a mission to create unique, interactive toys that get kids moving. We're a small but enthusiastic team that likes to work hard, move quickly, and bring thoughtful, engaging products to families across the country.


As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a talented Graphic Designer to help shape the visual identity of our products from concept to shelf.


Job Description:

We are seeking a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our team. This role focuses on graphic design execution for toys and baby gear products — including packaging, print artwork, character illustration, surface graphics, color studies, and visual concept development.


The ideal candidate has strong illustration skills, a sharp eye for color and composition, and experience creating graphics that resonate with both kids and modern parents. This is not an industrial design or soft goods design role — it is a graphics-first position embedded within product development.


**Portfolio or personal website is required.

**Professional fluency in English (written and spoken) is required.


Salary:

30-40K USD | 5-15% Bonus



Responsibilities:

  • Create original character illustrations and playful graphics for toys and baby products
  • Develop surface artwork for products (prints, patterns, decals, labels, etc.)
  • Conduct color studies and create cohesive color palettes across product lines
  • Prepare production-ready print files and packaging dielines
  • Collaborate closely with product designers, brand designers, engineers, and overseas manufacturers to ensure accurate execution
  • Develop instruction manuals, inserts, and other printed collateral
  • Design engaging retail packaging, including layout, typography, callouts, and compliance elements
  • Contribute to new product concepts with visual mockups and graphic direction
  • Maintain brand consistency across all product graphics
  • Stay up-to-date on design trends in toys, baby gear, illustration, and packaging
  • *Leverage AI platforms to enhance and expand design design tasks


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Illustration, or related field
  • 4+ years of experience in graphic design - experience in toys, baby products, or other consumer products is required.
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator and Photoshop required; InDesign strongly preferred)
  • Strong illustration skills (vector and/or hand-drawn style)
  • Experience preparing print-ready files and working with packaging dielines
  • Solid understanding of typography, color theory, and composition
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and move quickly in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail and organization
  • Experience working with overseas manufacturers is a plus
  • Passion for children’s products and understanding of what appeals to both kids and parents
  • *Experience working with AI platforms to improve design outputs


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience designing retail packaging for Amazon or mass retail
  • Experience with character development and brand mascots
  • Familiarity with basic 3D mockups or rendering tools
  • Understanding of toy safety labeling requirements
  • Experience working with licensed IP


Benefits:

  • Fully remote position
  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Creative and collaborative work environment
  • Opportunity to directly shape products sold nationally and internationally


  • If you’re a graphic designer who loves illustration, packaging, and creating playful yet beautiful products for kids and families, we’d love to hear from you!

  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful

  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O profissional que aceitar esse desafio será responsável por:

Identificar novas oportunidades estratégicas de crescimento, desenvolver e refinar propostas de valor claras e diferenciadas para entrada em novos segmentos e expansão na nossa base de clientes.

Estruturar e posicionar soluções que enderecem de forma eficaz as demandas e necessidades complexas dos clientes,

Definir tecnicamente a arquitetura e a estrutura das soluções propostas, garantindo alinhamento com a necessidade de negócio do cliente e a viabilidade técnica.

Realizar o acompanhamento contínuo de tendências tecnológicas, inovações e movimentos do mercado para antecipar necessidades e adaptar o portfólio de soluções.

Apoiar a execução da estratégia de vendas e a evolução do pipeline de oportunidades, produzindo documentos de visão e propostas que sejam aderentes aos problemas de negócio, orçamentos e prazos dos cliente e gerenciando o ciclo de vida do funil, desde a prospecção até o fechamento.

Experiência Sólida em funções de Business Development, Pré-Vendas, Consultoria Estratégica ou Arquitetura de Soluções, preferencialmente em um contexto B2B e B2G.

Profundo conhecimento e habilidade comprovada em estruturar propostas de valor, modelos de negócio e ofertas técnicas complexas.

Capacidade analítica e estratégica para identificar tendências, analisar dados de mercado e traduzi-los em planos de ação e oportunidades de negócio tangíveis.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, com capacidade de interagir e influenciar executivos e áreas técnicas.

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:

description:

Nossos valores — Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia — orientam todas as nossas decisões.

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade. Nosso processo seletivo é inclusivo e aberto a profissionais de todas as identidades, experiências e trajetórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um cliente multinacional de grande porte , do setor de petróleo e gás.

  • Conhecimento em programação (Python preferencial)
  • Conhecimentos em Cloud (Azure ou AWS)
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de Data Pipeline e Analytics
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD
  • Inglês fluente para comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Perfil analítico, senso de ownership e boa comunicação técnica


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência avançada com Snowflake (tasks/streams, stages, Snowpipe, performance tuning, RBAC, masking policies)
  • Experiência com Databricks
  • Vivência com dbt
  • Conhecimento em Azure Data Factory
  • Experiência com BODS
  • Fundamentos de DevOps
  • Conhecimento no domínio de trading


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa — regime 100% Home Office.

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Gastroenterologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Gastroenterologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.


  • Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);


Experiência:

  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
  • Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:

MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
The Role

As a RevOps Strategist, you will be the primary client-facing partner for several of our SaaS clients. You’ll work closely with the Founder/CEO during your first 3–6 months, joining calls together and learning our methodology. Over time, you will take ownership of the client relationship—shaping their RevOps strategy, managing ongoing deliverables, and guiding a team of RevOps Analysts on execution.


This role blends:

  • Client strategy & communication
  • RevOps problem-solving & system architecture
  • Hands-on tool knowledge (especially HubSpot)
  • Scoping, prioritizing, and quality-checking technical work


This is not a “ticket-taker” role. You’ll be a strategic partner, trusted advisor, and cross-functional operator helping early- and growth-stage SaaS companies scale their go-to-market operations.


What You’ll Do


RevOps Strategy

  • Partner with clients to build and evolve their RevOps strategy across the full funnel (Marketing, Sales, CS).
  • Proactively identify gaps, opportunities, and process improvements.
  • Translate business goals into concrete RevOps initiatives and technical requirements.
  • Provide perspective on best practices across areas such as:
  • Lead flow design
  • Pipeline management
  • Process automation & workflow optimization
  • CRM governance
  • GTM integrations
  • Reporting & analytics
  • AI implementation for GTM workflows


Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for 3–6 clients.
  • Run weekly/bi-weekly client meetings, deliver updates, and document decisions.
  • Communicate proactively via Slack and email with clarity, professionalism, and consistency.
  • Build trusted relationships with GTM leaders (Marketing, Sales, RevOps, CS).


Implementation Leadership & Quality Assurance

  • Work with our RevOps Analysts to scope, prioritize, and assign technical work.
  • Review deliverables for accuracy, strategy alignment, and data integrity.
  • Jump into tools directly (especially HubSpot) when needed to troubleshoot or validate.
  • Ensure high-quality execution that reflects Floodlight Growth standards.


About You

You are a hybrid: part RevOps strategist, part systems thinker, part client partner. You’re comfortable both solving a strategic GTM problem and advising on how to execute it in HubSpot.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on RevOps or Marketing/Sales Ops experience.
  • Advanced HubSpot experience (CRM, workflows, custom objects, lead routing, reporting).
  • Experience with Salesforce, Clay, sales engagement tools, and GTM integrations strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience working across the full revenue funnel.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable.
  • Ability to turn a business conversation into clear technical requirements.
  • Comfortable collaborating with technical implementers—and reviewing their work.


Bonus Skills

  • Experience at a B2B SaaS company (ideally venture-backed).
  • Experience in consulting, client services, or agency environments.
  • Familiarity with automation platforms (Zapier, n8n, Workato).
  • Strong analytical skills (e.g., Looker, Snowflake, HubSpot reporting).

title: Senior Content Manager
description:

You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams.   • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders

  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations

The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals

You work well with others and think ahead:

What’s in it for you

title: DTC Video Editor (Health & Wellness)
description:
Company Description

We are a fast-growing, Shopify-based DTC health brand in the pain relief space, focused primarily on back pain and sciatica.

Our products are therapy-driven and positioned at the intersection of medical credibility and direct-response performance marketing.

We scale primarily through paid acquisition (Meta & Google), and long-form VSL creative (2–10+ minutes) is one of the core growth levers of our company.

Creative execution is not optional here. It directly impacts revenue.

We are now looking for a high-level Senior Video Editor who understands performance marketing and can execute long-form VSLs at a high standard.


Role Overview

You will be responsible for editing long-form VSLs (2–10+ minutes) and performance-driven paid ads across multiple platforms.

You must understand:

• Retention pacing

• Direct-response storytelling

• Visual hierarchy

• Conversion psychology

• Editing for watch time and sales, not just aesthetics

You will work directly with leadership and creative direction to turn scripts into high-performing acquisition assets.


Minimum Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

  • 3–5+ years of professional video editing experience
  • Proven experience editing long-form VSLs (portfolio required)
  • Experience editing paid direct-response ads for DTC brands
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Strong proficiency in After Effects (or equivalent for motion graphics)
  • Deep understanding of retention-based pacing and performance editing
  • Ability to follow detailed creative briefs precisely
  • Ability to take feedback quickly and iterate without ego
  • High attention to detail and high production standards

Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.


Technical Skills Required

You must be able to execute:

  • Long-form VSL editing (5–10+ minutes, narrative-driven)
  • Motion graphics overlays
  • Animated callouts and dynamic visual highlights
  • Anatomical overlays (not developed from scratch) and concept-explainer visual effects
  • Product-focused motion elements (outlines, glow effects, benefit visualizations)
  • Pain-point animations (ex: radiating nerve pain)
  • Clean subtitle systems and visual retention elements
  • Seamless integration of b-roll, testimonials, AI voiceovers, and UGC content

You should understand how to visually reinforce claims and concepts without making content look exaggerated or gimmicky.


Bonus Points

  • Experience editing in health, wellness, or medical-adjacent niches
  • Experience with high-spend DTC brands
  • Experience collaborating closely with copywriters and creative strategists
  • Understanding of awareness levels and performance angles
  • Familiarity with Slack, Notion, Frame.io workflows


What You'll Be Doing

  • Edit long-form VSLs used as primary acquisition creatives
  • Edit short and mid-length paid ads derived from VSL content
  • Add motion graphics and anatomical overlays to enhance clarity and perceived efficacy
  • Translate scripts into visually engaging, high-retention video
  • Maintain brand consistency across all edits
  • Iterate based on performance data and feedback
  • Deliver assets reliably and on schedule

We move quickly and expect tight execution.


Who Is This Role For?

  • An editor who thinks beyond cutting clips
  • Someone who understands that editing impacts profitability
  • Someone who takes ownership
  • Someone who wants to build high-level performance skills
  • Someone who wants their work to directly impact scaling

This is not for beginners.

This is not for cinematic YouTube vlog editors.

This is for performance-driven editors.


Compensation & Structure

  • $2,000–$3,000 USD per month (based on experience)
  • Performance-based bonus
  • Full-time (40 hours per week)
  • Fully remote
  • Long-term growth potential


Application Process

To apply, send:

  • Your resume
  • Your portfolio (VSL examples required)
  • A short paragraph explaining your experience with performance-driven editing


If you are an experienced VSL editor who understands direct response and can execute at a high level, we want to see your work.


We are hiring immediately.

title: Application Support Engineer
description:
MatchPoint Solutions is a fast-growing, young, energetic global IT-Engineering services company with clients across the US . We provide technology solutions to various clients like Uber, Robinhood, Netflix, Airbnb, Google, Sephora, and more! More recently, we have expanded to working internationally in Canada, China, Ireland, UK, Brazil, and India . Through our culture of innovation, we inspire, build, and deliver business results, from idea to outcome. We keep our clients on the cutting edge of the latest technologies and provide solutions by using industry-specific best practices and expertise.


We are excited to be continuously expanding our team. If you are interested in this position, please send over your updated resume. We look forward to hearing from you!



Job Title: Application Support Engineer

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Role Description: The Application Support Engineer is responsible for administering and supporting the ticketing system, as well as providing operational support, maintenance, and lifecycle management for both SaaS (vendor-managed) and self-managed enterprise applications. This role ensures applications are secure, available, performant, and compliant, while serving as a key coordination point between vendors, internal infrastructure teams, InfoSec, and business stakeholders.

Mandatory Experience: SaaS-Ticketing system, Atlassian suite, Jira. also have experience managing on-premise applications running on windows or Linux platforms that require patch and update deployment. The most important qualities are independence and a strong willingness to learn.


Job Experience Requirements:

  • 3–7 years of experience supporting the ticketing system and enterprise applications across SaaS and self-managed models.
  • Hands-on experience with application deployments, patching, and maintenance for self-managed systems.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS operating models, vendor support, and SLA management.
  • Experience with ITIL processes (incident, change, problem, request management).
  • Hands-on experience in administering and supporting ticketing systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot across applications, infrastructure, and integration layers.
  • Strong communication skills to work with vendors and cross-functional IT teams.
  • Experience supporting business-critical or regulated applications.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and hybrid environments.
  • Knowledge of IAM, observability, and security controls.

Job Responsibilities:

Self-Managed Application Support

  • Perform application maintenance for self-managed applications, including deployment of application updates, patches, and fixes.
  • Support production and non-production environments (dev, test, staging, prod).
  • Execute deployments following approved change management (CAB) processes.
  • Monitor application health, availability, and performance; troubleshoot and resolve L2/L3 issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with Cloud Infrastructure, IAM, and InfoSec teams for changes and remediation.

SaaS (Managed Service) Application Support

  • Act as the primary IT point of contact for SaaS applications managed by external vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support escalations, and SLA adherence.
  • Coordinate SaaS releases, upgrades, and vendor-led changes, including impact assessment and business communications.
  • Validate vendor patching, security updates, and release notes for enterprise impact.
  • Support SaaS configuration changes, user provisioning, role management, and integrations.
  • Partner with InfoSec and Compliance to support risk assessments, audits, and vendor reviews.

Incident, Request & Service Management

  • Provide L2/L3 support for incidents and service requests across SaaS and self-managed applications.
  • Collaborate with GSD / Client Services for L1 support and escalation workflows.
  • Ensure timely resolution, stakeholder communication, and proper ticket documentation.

Security, Compliance & Risk

  • Support application patching and vulnerability remediation (self-managed) and validation (SaaS).
  • Ensure applications align with IAM, data protection, and enterprise security standards.
  • Support audit, SOX, GxP, and compliance activities by providing operational evidence.

Governance, Documentation & Lifecycle Management

  • Maintain application documentation, runbooks, and support models.
  • Participate in application onboarding, upgrades, renewals, and decommissioning.
  • Support application rationalization and standardization initiatives.

title: Senior Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
Senior Data Pipeline Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure that powers our platform, building integrations, transformations, and orchestration that ensure reliable, analytics-ready data for hundreds of customer workspaces.


Position Overview:


For our Client we're hiring a Senior Data Pipeline Engineer to own and scale the data infrastructure powering our platform. You'll build integrations from marketing and sales platforms, transform raw data into analytics-ready models, and orchestrate pipelines that run reliably across hundreds of customer workspaces. This foundational role requires architectural thinking, experience with ELT patterns, columnar storage, and multi-tenant systems. If you love designing clean data models, building robust pipelines, and connecting new data sources end-to-end, this is the role for you.


What You'll Do

  • Expand our data integrations — add new source connectors (ad platforms, social media, payment processors) with full extraction, loading, transformation, and orchestration flows
  • Write and maintain incremental SQL transformation models across staging, core, and analytics layers optimized for a columnar analytics engine
  • Design and maintain orchestration workflows — event-driven sensors, schedules, partitions, and automated pipeline chains
  • Optimize our analytics warehouse — schema design, partitioning strategies, materialized views, sort keys, and data retention policies for performance at scale
  • Scale our multi-tenant architecture — each customer workspace gets isolated databases, and you'll manage the per-tenant pipeline lifecycle
  • Build data quality checks, freshness monitoring, alerting, and pipeline health dashboards


What You Bring

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in data engineering — we care about your growth trajectory, not just time served
  • Strong SQL skills — CTEs, window functions, complex aggregations, and performance tuning for analytical workloads
  • Production experience with columnar analytics databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar OLAP engines)
  • Hands-on experience with ELT pipelines and SQL transformation frameworks (dbt or similar)
  • Experience with modern data orchestration tools (Dagster, Airflow, Prefect, or similar)
  • Comfortable writing data pipeline code in Python
  • Experience with cloud-based data integration platforms for managing source connectors and sync configurations
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience


Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketing and ads platform APIs (TikTok, Meta, Google Ads, Pinterest)
  • Background in multi-tenant data architecture — per-customer database isolation and credential management
  • E-commerce domain knowledge — orders, customers, transactions, RFM segmentation, customer lifetime value
  • Experience with PostgreSQL and cross-database patterns between relational and analytical databases
  • Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript — our console is built with Next.js, and wiring integrations into the frontend is a plus
  • Understanding of how data models feed into AI/LLM agent systems


Who You Are

  • You have a genuine drive to learn and grow — we hire for potential and curiosity as much as current skill
  • You think in systems — you see how extraction, transformation, orchestration, and the analytics layer fit together as one whole
  • You take ownership end-to-end — from designing the schema to monitoring the pipeline in production
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and can make sound architectural decisions without a playbook for every situation
  • You communicate clearly and enjoy working directly with founders and cross-functional teammates


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

  • Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Gerente de loja

A CK é uma marca norte-americana fundada em 1968 na cidade de Nova York, e que manteve sua iconicidade e atemporalidade até os dias atuais. Este nome se expandiu ao redor do mundo, e por isso hoje está presente em vários países, inclusive no Brasil.


Nacionalmente contamos com +2.000 pontos de venda, além de termos nossa matriz corporativa presente na cidade de São Paulo, e contarmos com 2 centros de distribuição: um em Cotia/SP, e outro em Serra/ES.


Nosso propósito é “impulsionar a moda para o bem”, além de termos como visão “sermos a marca de fashion lifestyle mais admirada do mundo!”. Para isso, temos alguns valores como individualidade, integridade, paixão, parceria e responsabilidade.


Além disso, a CK é conhecida por seu grande compromisso com Diversidade e Inclusão! Todas as nossas vagas são direcionadas a todos os públicos, valorizando a pluralidade de identidades e experiências. Por isso, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas negras, LGBTQIAPN+, pessoas com deficiência, indígenas, de diferentes gerações, e outros tipos de diversidade. title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page.


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir o entendimento funcional detalhado junto aos Business Partners (BPs), garantindo total coerência entre a necessidade real do negócio e a solução sistêmica proposta;
  • Converter Histórias de Usuário (HU) em especificações funcionais (FS) e desenhos técnicos (DS) detalhados, contemplando regras de negócio, tratativa de exceções e validações complexas;
  • Elaborar fluxogramas de processos (AS-IS / TO-BE) e modelos em notação BPMN para suportar o entendimento end-to-end das cadeias de valor;
  • Mapear de forma exaustiva as integrações, dados mestres, dependências entre objetos SAP e impactos cruzados entre módulos;
  • Atuar em colaboração direta com Especialistas SAP (ABAP/Integration) e Liderança Técnica para validar a viabilidade e performance das soluções desenhadas;
  • Criar cenários de testes funcionais abrangentes e suportar a execução de testes integrados, smoke tests e homologação de usuário (UAT);
  • Acompanhar o ciclo de vida da entrega, validando correções, parametrizações e garantindo a qualidade dos transportes até o ambiente de Produção (PRD);
  • Produzir e manter documentação funcional clara, estruturada e aderente aos padrões de governança do programa;
  • Apoiar a governança funcional da TI, zelando pela manutenção de templates, boas práticas e padronização da documentação.


O que você precisa ter

  • Vivência sólida em projetos de implementação ou sustentação de SAP S/4HANA, especificamente no módulo ACM (Agricultural Contract Management);
  • Experiência comprovada na elaboração de Especificações Funcionais (FS) e Técnicas (DS);
  • Conhecimento prático de processos empresariais end-to-end (OTC, P2P, Logística e Integração com Balança/Armazenagem);
  • Domínio de SAP S/4HANA (Módulo ACM);
  • Interpretação de requisitos em formato BDD (Given/When/Then);
  • Modelagem de processos (BPMN) e ferramentas de diagramação;
  • Conhecimento sobre arquitetura de integração SAP (APIs, IDOCs) e sistemas satélites;
  • Metodologia de projeto SAP Activate.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência funcional híbrida (conhecimento em módulos correlatos como SD, MM ou TM);
  • Conhecimento profundo das especificidades do setor de Agronegócio (Commodities, Originação, Fixação);
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de manuais e notas SAP.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: High-Stakes Poker Specialist
description:
EUROPROP® Trading is a performance-driven trading and digital asset firm operating at the intersection of quantitative strategy, risk management, and high-level decision science. We apply disciplined capital allocation principles across financial markets and strategic gaming environments where probabilistic thinking and risk optimization are critical.


Our team is composed of professionals with backgrounds in trading, analytics, game theory, and behavioral strategy. As we expand our strategic gaming division, we are seeking a highly skilled High-Stakes Poker Specialist to apply advanced decision-making, bankroll management, and risk-adjusted performance strategies in competitive high-stakes environments.


This is a unique opportunity to operate in a capital-backed, analytically structured environment where performance, discipline, and strategic edge are paramount.


Key Responsibilities
  • Compete in high-stakes online poker environments using advanced game theory optimal (GTO) and exploitative strategies.
  • Manage allocated bankroll with strict risk management and capital preservation principles.
  • Analyze hand histories, opponent tendencies, and statistical performance data to optimize win rate.
  • Continuously refine strategy based on solver outputs, probability modeling, and EV optimization.
  • Maintain detailed performance reporting, including ROI, variance metrics, and drawdown control.
  • Collaborate with internal analysts to enhance strategic frameworks and long-term profitability.


Requirements
  • Proven experience competing successfully in high-stakes online poker games.
  • Strong understanding of game theory, probability, variance, and bankroll management principles.
  • Demonstrated consistent profitability over a statistically meaningful sample size.
  • Experience using poker solvers and tracking software.
  • High emotional discipline and ability to perform under pressure.
  • Strong analytical mindset with structured decision-making skills.
  • Fluent English communication skills.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fully remote environment.


What We Offer
  • Competitive annual compensation R$360,000–R$420,000 plus performance-based incentives.
  • Fully remote position within Brazil.
  • Structured capital allocation with disciplined bankroll strategy.
  • Data-driven, professional performance environment.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with quantitative analysts and strategic experts.
  • Performance bonuses tied directly to profitability and risk-adjusted returns.
